name: elastic-accordion
title: Elastic Accordion
description: An accordion whose panels open with elastic overshoot: neighbouring rows are pushed with a spring-lag (each row's displacement chases the row above), so the stack wobbles like a slinky instead of snapping rigid.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Playful
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Rounded
Motion: Expressive
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Click Expand: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
